title: EphB2-Fc precipitates from rat hippocampal neurons in culture and from brain lysates
protocol: Homogenize a murine brain in 2 ml LBA lysis buffer.
Spin down at 16,000 g for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Take the supernatant and measure protein concentration.
Incubate 1.5 mg of protein with protein-G sepharose beads for 30 minutes at 4°C.
Spin samples down at 6,000 g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Incubate pre-cleared supernatants overnight at 4°C with protein-G Sepharose beads and 5 μg EphB2-Fc or Fc to precipitate unspecific proteins.
Spin them down at 6,000 g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Wash beads three times with HNTG buffer.
Add 20 μl loading buffer.
Boil samples for 5 minutes and load in a 9% SDS-PAGE gel.
Develop the gel by Western blot using the desired antibodies.
Cluster EphB2-Fc or Fc one hour prior to stimulation at room temperature: Mix EphB2-Fc/Fc at 1 μg/ml with anti-hFc at 0.1 μg/ml.
Wash neurons twice with HBSS.
Add pre-warmed EphB2-Fc/Fc clusters in NB medium to the neurons and incubate at 37°C for 1 hour.
Place plates on ice and wash cells twice with cold PBS.
Lyse cells in PLC buffer, incubate at 4°C for 10 minutes, then spin down samples at 16,000 g for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Take the supernatant and measure protein concentration.
Incubate 3 mg total protein from neuron lysates with protein-G Sepharose beads for 1 hour at 4°C.
Add 10 μg of EphB2-Fc or Fc to the appropriate sample.
Incubate overnight at 4°C.
Spin samples down at 6,000 g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Wash beads three times with HNTG buffer.
Add 20 μl loading buffer.
Boil samples for 5 minutes.
Resolve samples in a 7.5% SDS-PAGE gel.
Develop the Western blot using the desired antibodies.
